/referencA player’s on-base percentage is calculated by dividing the total number of times the batter reached at least first base by total plate appearances (not including sacrifice bunts). The formula in terms of variables in the Lahman Batting table is OBP = H + BB + HBP AB + BB + SF + HBP . Create a tibble named BatOBP that contains the average OBP for each team, arranged from largest to smallest. Player stats from different years can be considered as different data towards the average. (Hint: You’ll want to filter out player-years that make the denominator for OBP come out to zero.)e/tibble.html
